//go:build !(go1.27 && !http2legacy)

// Copied into the upstream test package by test_upstream.py.
package http2_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"

	. "golang.org/x/net/http2"
)

func TestRelayDirectionalFINConnectionCredits(t *testing.T) {
	for _, clientFirst := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "target_first"
		if clientFirst {
			name = "client_first"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
				closeResponse := make(chan struct{})
				read := make(chan struct{})
				done := make(chan struct{})
				st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
					defer close(done)
					if clientFirst {
						<-closeResponse
					}
					if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
						return
					}
					<-read
					if n, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r.Body); n != 4096 || err != nil {
						t.Errorf("final upload = %d bytes, %v; want 4096 bytes and EOF", n, err)
					}
				}, func(s *Server) {
					s.MaxUploadBufferPerConnection = 131070
					s.MaxUploadBufferPerStream = 131070
				})
				defer st.Close()
				st.greet()
				st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
					StreamID:      1,
					BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
					EndHeaders:    true,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
				st.writeData(1, true, make([]byte, 4096))
				if clientFirst {
					close(closeResponse)
				}
				synctest.Wait()
				close(read)
				<-done
				synctest.Wait()
				st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
			})
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayCloseWriteHandlerReturnReleasesStream(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		if st.streamExists(1) {
			t.Error("handler returned but stream still consumes capacity waiting for client FIN")
		}
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing receive-direction reset after handler return")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeNo {
					t.Fatalf("handler completion reset = %s, want NO_ERROR", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	})
}

func TestRelayInterruptStreamUnblocksFlowControlledWrite(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		interrupt := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := w.Write(make([]byte, 128<<10))
				writeDone <- err
			}()
			<-interrupt
			if err := w.(interface{ InterruptStream(uint32) error }).InterruptStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			if err := <-writeDone; err == nil {
				t.Error("flow-controlled write completed without a cancellation error")
			}
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("handler ended before cancellation")
		default:
		}
		close(interrupt)
		synctest.Wait()
		<-done
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing cancellation reset")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeCancel {
					t.Fatalf("cancellation reset = %s, want CANCEL", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
	})
}

func TestRelayInterruptStreamUnblocksNetworkWrite(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		write := make(chan struct{})
		interrupt := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		payload := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xa5}, 32<<10)
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
			<-write
			writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := w.Write(payload)
				writeDone <- err
			}()
			<-interrupt
			if err := w.(interface{ InterruptStream(uint32) error }).InterruptStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			if err := <-writeDone; err == nil {
				t.Error("network-blocked write completed without a cancellation error")
			}
			// A caller may reuse its Write buffer immediately after cancellation.
			clear(payload)
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		st.wantFrameType(FrameHeaders)
		// H2 still has its full initial window; only the underlying socket
		// write is blocked. A queued reset cannot reach the peer yet.
		conn := st.cc.(*synctestNetConn)
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(0)
		close(write)
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("handler ended before cancellation")
		default:
		}
		close(interrupt)
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
		default:
			t.Fatal("cancellation waited for a reset blocked on the network")
		}
		if st.streamExists(1) {
			t.Error("canceled stream retained local capacity")
		}
		// Resuming the peer must deliver the encoded DATA unchanged followed
		// by the original reset code, without referencing a pooled writer.
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(64 << 10)
		synctest.Wait()
		var sawData bool
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing cancellation reset after network resumed")
			}
			if data, ok := f.(*DataFrame); ok {
				sawData = true
				if !bytes.Equal(data.Data(), bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xa5}, len(data.Data()))) {
					t.Error("in-flight DATA referenced the reused handler buffer")
				}
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeCancel {
					t.Fatalf("cancellation reset = %s, want CANCEL", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if !sawData {
			t.Error("test did not exercise an in-flight DATA write")
		}
	})
}

func TestRelayResetAfterDirectionalFINKeepsErrorCode(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeConnect)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing target-error reset")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeConnect {
					t.Fatalf("target error after FIN = %s, want CONNECT_ERROR", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	})
}
